description: Which drug acquisition costs changed this week? NADAC per-unit cost changes and NDCs added or dropped, with CMS’s stated reason, 2025 on, from CMS’s weekly NADAC files. Change records between consecutive weekly NADAC files (2025 on): an NDC whose per-unit NADAC changed (with CMS’s primary reason from the NADAC Comparison file when it gives one), an NDC added (old null) or dropped (new null). Each record cites the sha256 of the files of both weeks. Pages of up to 100, oldest first; pass next_cursor back as cursor. Updated weekly. Price: $0.05 per call. Free tier: 3 free calls a day per IP, at most 3 rows per answer, taken by an unpaid call unless its _meta["distill/free-tier"] is "skip". Confidence: Freshness only (the values are CMS’s, read deterministically): 1 until 9 days after the latest weekly file’s as-of date, then halving every 14 days. National Average Drug Acquisition Cost as CMS publishes it weekly: a survey average of what retail pharmacies pay per unit, not a retail price, a reimbursement rate, a quote or medical advice. See /terms.

since.description: Only records detected after this time (ISO 8601); a record is detected on its week’s as-of day.

week.description: Only the changes of the weekly file with this as-of date, e.g. 2026-10-21.
